title: ErrorEnvelope
description: AI/ML service HTTP error envelope per Decision 10 and §20.2 (strictly for unprocessable requests: INVALID_REQUEST, UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE, RUN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; blocked AI steps return HTTP 200 with ai_step.error_code). Includes optional error.reason for T-17 V2.12 compatibility where shared with execution-service.
